name: codex-attachment-manager
description: For Codex tasks with many images: earlier images go out as short placeholders instead of being sent again with every message, the model fetches the original back by its ID (also after compaction), and the prompt cache keeps working.

interface.shortDescription: Stop sending earlier images again with every message
interface.longDescription:
In a long task, Codex sends every earlier image again with each message, so a task with many images gets slow and can stop going through. This plugin numbers each image (IMG-001, IMG-002, …) and sends earlier ones as short placeholders instead. When the model needs an earlier image again, it fetches the original back by its ID, also after the task is compacted. A placeholder is written once and then stays the same, so the earlier conversation is still read from the prompt cache. Nothing is deleted, and all data stays on your machine; nothing is sent anywhere besides the requests Codex already makes to your configured model provider. Once enabled, it works by itself; in the panel you can also find an image by a detail you remember, keep a reference image in every turn, or turn off Auto-select and choose the images yourself. After installing, open the panel (side panel → New tab → Plugins and MCPs → Context Assets), click "Enable plugin", then restart Codex. Before removing the plugin, click "Disable plugin" in the panel first. The panel follows Codex's language: English, Simplified Chinese or Japanese.

长任务里，Codex 每发一条消息，都会把之前所有的图再发一遍，图一多，任务就越来越慢，最后可能发不出去。这个插件给每张图编号（IMG-001、IMG-002……），之前的图改成发一段简短的占位。模型需要再看之前的某张图时，按编号取回原图，任务压缩之后也可以。占位符只写一次，之后不再变，之前的对话照常从缓存（prompt cache）读取。什么都不删，所有数据只留在本机；除了 Codex 本来就要发给你配置的模型服务的请求，不向任何地方发送数据。启用后自动生效；在面板里还可以凭印象找图，让重要的参考图每轮都发，或者关掉自动选图、自己决定带哪些图。装好后打开面板（侧边面板 → 新建标签页 → 插件和 MCP → 上下文素材），点“启用插件”，再重启 Codex。移除插件前，请先在面板里点“停用插件”。面板跟随 Codex 的界面语言，支持简体中文、英文和日文。
